name: ITPS310 Midterm Topic 2 - Foundations of Information Security and Cybersecurity

questions.questionText: The practice of protecting information from unauthorized access.
The practice of protecting computers, networks, applications, online accounts, and digital information from cyber threats.
It means ensuring that information is only accessed by authorized people.

name: ITPS310 Midterm Topic 1 - Foundations of Information Assurance and Security

questions.questionText: Information is accessible only to authorized people, systems, or processes.
Information remains accurate, complete and protected against unauthorized modification.
Information and services are accessible to authorized users when required.
Actions can be reliably traced to the responsible person or system.
Users, devices, and systems are verified to be genuinely who or what they claim to be.
Operations can be continued or be stored quickly after disruption.
These are the trained employees, security professionals, and informed users.
Clear rules for how information must be handled.
Firewalls, encryption, access controls, and monitoring systems.
Leadership commitment and clear accountability structures.
Systematic identification of threats and vulnerabilitlies.
Plans to maintain or restore critical operations.
Continuous testing, auditing, and improvement.
